    Chapter · The octave of immersion

    Eight stages: a circle walked by yourself

    The stages follow the ring: from the One through the cosmos to the human, deep into matter, into the void and back. Stage zero is the threshold; stage seven begins a new turn of the spiral. Each stage has four steps.

    Practice

    Heart breathing

    Six breaths a minute: breathe in for 5 seconds, breathe out for 5 seconds. This rhythm increases heart rate variability. With music on, a bell rings on each in-breath.
